answer: A proof-of-inference protocol resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to solve periodic, time-sensitive multimodal challenges, such as analyzing sensor feeds of an offshore jetty, spectral emissions from a comet, or resonant density in structural timber. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of leasing dedicated neural accelerator silicon and electricity per identity. However, this mechanism consumes substantial energy and penalizes lightweight edge agents with limited processing power.
